args.body:
NUMBERED DEVIATION-AND-EXPOSURE ANNEX
Corvid Analytics LLC rev B Counter-Draft of Northgale Systems MSA v2 (Execution-Ready Base)
Negotiation File — Supporting Harrow & Vane LLP / Northgale Systems, Inc.

Preamble — Measurement Basis. This annex evaluates each rev B change against (i) the Northgale client-form MSA v2, (ii) the Corvid Analytics rev B counter-draft (operative transmittal of 9 July 2026; the superseded rev A of 26 June 2026 is disregarded), and (iii) the Northgale Commercial Contracting Playbook, 2026 Edition. Dollar impacts are computed at the monthly base service fee stated in the agreement, $85,000/month (client form §4.1), in accordance with the General Counsel's engagement instruction letter of 14 July 2026 and the playbook drafting note requiring exposure to be quantified at the current monthly run-rate.

DEVIATION 1 — Renewal Periods (client form §2.2 vs. rev B change 1)
  Client-form position: Automatic renewal in successive one (1) year periods.
  Markup position: Successive two (2) year renewal periods (capacity planning).
  Playbook standard: One (1) year periods (PB-1). Approved fallback: NONE — multi-year renewal periods are out of policy and require CLO approval.
  Dollar impact: No discrete per-period fee change; the incremental commitment exposure from a two-year renewal period (vs. the one-year standard) is a doubling of the committed service term per renewal cycle, i.e., exposure of 24 months at $85,000/month = $2,040,000 for a single two-year renewal cycle as compared to $1,020,000 for a one-year cycle. Escalation required to CLO.

DEVIATION 2 — Late Interest Rate (client form §4.3 vs. rev B change 2)
  Client-form position: Interest on late undisputed amounts at 1.0% per month.
  Markup position: 1.5% per month.
  Playbook standard: Late interest never above 1.0% per month (PB-4). Approved fallback: NONE above 1.0%.
  Dollar impact: The 0.5% incremental monthly rate above the 1.0% standard applies to any principal subject to interest when due. No principal amount is stated in the documents; the deviation is the rate spread of +0.5% per month against the playbook ceiling of 1.0%. Reject; do not counter.

DEVIATION 3 — NEW §4.4 Suspension of Services (rev B change 3)
  Client-form position: No suspension right (client form §4.3 grants Provider no right to suspend for non-payment).
  Markup position: Provider may suspend Services if any undisputed invoice remains unpaid fifteen (15) days after its due date.
  Playbook standard: Suspension-of-services rights are out of policy unless preceded by at least thirty (30) days' written cure notice, and any suspension right requires CFO sign-off (PB-4).
  Dollar impact: No stated fee amount attaches to the suspension clause itself. The gap versus the playbook standard is the 15-day suspension trigger (vs. required 30-day cure notice) and the absence of CFO sign-off. Reject as drafted; any concession requires CFO sign-off.

DEVIATION 4 — Convenience Termination Notice (client form §7.2 vs. rev B change 4)
  Client-form position: Thirty (30) days' prior written notice to terminate for convenience.
  Markup position: Ninety (90) days' prior written notice.
  Playbook standard: Thirty (30) days (PB-2). Approved fallback: up to forty-five (45) days. Escalation trigger: any notice period above 45 days requires CLO approval.
  Dollar impact: Each additional day Northgale remains obligated during the extended notice period carries the $85,000 monthly run-rate (~$2,795/day at 30 days per month). Moving from 30 to 90 days adds 60 days (~$167,000 at the monthly run-rate) of continued fee exposure before exit; counter at the playbook fallback of 45 days rather than accept 90.

DEVIATION 5 — NEW §7.4 Wind-Down (rev B change 5)
  Client-form position: No wind-down period and no wind-down compensation (client form §7.2).
  Markup position: Sixty (60) day wind-down upon any termination other than Provider's uncured material breach, during which Customer pays the full monthly base service fee for wind-down services plus all committed third-party costs.
  Playbook standard: A post-termination wind-down is acceptable only if (i) capped at thirty (30) days and (ii) compensation is limited to documented out-of-pocket costs and non-cancelable third-party commitments. Full-fee wind-down compensation is out of policy (PB-3).
  Dollar impact (full-fee wind-down cost): The markup's 60-day wind-down at the full monthly base fee equals 2 months × $85,000 = $170,000 in full-fee compensation, before any committed third-party costs. Against the playbook's out-of-pocket-only standard, the $170,000 full-fee component is out-of-policy premium exposure; the playbook permits only documented out-of-pocket and non-cancelable third-party commitments, capped at 30 days (i.e., 1 month × monthly run-rate, or $85,000 at most, and only for documented out-of-pocket/third-party costs — not full fees). Reject full-fee compensation; no more than 30 days at out-of-pocket only.

DEVIATION 6 — Liability Cap Measurement Period (client form §9.1 vs. rev B change 6)
  Client-form position: Cap measured at Fees paid or payable in the twenty-four (24) months preceding the first event giving rise to liability.
  Markup position: Twelve (12) months.
  Playbook standard: Twenty-four (24) months. Approved fallback floor: eighteen (18) months. A twelve (12) month measurement period is below the fallback floor and requires CLO approval (PB-5).
  Dollar impact — liability cap value at the stated monthly base fee of $85,000:
    • Client-form measurement period (24 months): 24 × $85,000 = $2,040,000.
    • Markup's proposed measurement period (12 months): 12 × $85,000 = $1,020,000.
    • Playbook approved fallback floor (18 months): 18 × $85,000 = $1,530,000.
  The rev B period reduces Northgale's protectable cap exposure by $1,020,000 relative to the client-form cap (from $2,040,000 to $1,020,000). Counter at the 18-month playbook fallback floor ($1,530,000) at minimum; the 12-month ask requires CLO approval.

DEVIATION 7 — Carve-Outs (client form §9.2 vs. rev B change 7)
  Client-form position: The §9.1 cap does not apply to (a) confidentiality breach, (b) IP indemnification, or (c) gross negligence or willful misconduct.
  Markup position: Rev B deletes clause (c), so gross negligence and willful misconduct are subject to the §9.1 cap; clauses (a) and (b) are retained.
  Playbook standard: The carve-outs for confidentiality, IP indemnification, and gross negligence/willful misconduct are non-negotiable; deletion of any carve-out requires joint CLO and CFO approval (PB-5).
  Dollar impact: Deleting the gross-negligence/willful-misconduct carve-out caps that exposure at the applicable measurement-period value — at the markup's 12-month period, $1,020,000; at the client-form 24-month period, $2,040,000. Because the playbook treats this carve-out as non-negotiable, deletion requires joint CLO and CFO approval regardless of quantum. Reject deletion.

DEVIATION 8 — Service Credit Cap (client form §11.2 vs. rev B change 8)
  Client-form position: Aggregate service-credit cap of 20% of the monthly base service fee in any calendar month.
  Markup position: Aggregate cap of 10%.
  Playbook standard: Aggregate monthly credit cap of 20% of the monthly fee. Approved fallback floor: fifteen percent (15%). A 10% aggregate credit cap is out of policy (PB-6).
  Dollar impact — maximum monthly service credit at the monthly base fee of $85,000:
    • Client-form credit cap (20%): 20% × $85,000 = $17,000/month maximum service credit.
    • Markup's reduced credit cap (10%): 10% × $85,000 = $8,500/month maximum service credit.
  The rev B cap cuts the maximum recoverable monthly credit by $8,500/month (from $17,000 to $8,500). Counter at the playbook fallback floor of 15% ($12,750/month, i.e., 15% × $85,000); the 10% cap is out of policy.

SUMMARY OF ESCALATION / APPROVAL ITEMS
  • Earlier withdrawn rev A transmittal disregarded in this analysis per the GC instruction letter; only rev B is operative.
  • Renewal-period change (Deviation 1): requires CLO approval.
  • Convenience termination above 45 days (Deviation 4): requires CLO approval (counter at 45-day fallback).
  • Full-fee wind-down (Deviation 5): out of policy; counter to 30 days out-of-pocket only.
  • Liability cap below 18-month floor (Deviation 6): 12-month period requires CLO approval; counter at 18-month floor ($1,530,000).
  • Carve-out deletion (Deviation 7): requires joint CLO and CFO approval; reject.
  • Service credit cap below 15% floor (Deviation 8): 10% cap out of policy; counter at 15% fallback ($12,750/month).
  • Suspension of services (Deviation 3): out of policy as drafted; any concession requires CFO sign-off.

Prepared as a negotiation-file deliverable to accompany the counter-turn redline and the Deal Committee escalation memo. Figures are computed solely from amounts stated in the agreement, rev B markup, playbook, and instruction letter.
